name: Image optimizer
description: Example JS plugin (CMS 2.1.0): shrinks JPEG and PNG uploads that are wider than a limit and re-encodes them (media.uploaded → media.read → media.resize → media.replace), keeping the original when the result is not smaller; refuses images over a size limit before they are stored (media.beforeSave).
author: Anasaki Studio
